1_blockout.notes: SCULPT REFERENCE ONLY - never shipped, never copied to assets/models/, never rigged. TRELLIS.2 (Pixal3D pruned) on the mirrored hero front; birefnet cut-out verified against a colour key over a fitted background (pauldrons, fist, cannon, cape tatters and boots kept); 3 seeds (101/202/303) at the user's character settings (700k faces, 4096 px), 40-44 min each on the shared GPU. s202 picked: the only seed with the anvil plate mounted on the chest (s101 floats it as a separate shell, s303 half-detaches it), by far the cleanest surface (one main shell, largest hole 1.1 cm vs 0.24-0.26 m openings in s101/s303), a solid cape with the tatters at the hem, separated from the legs, and span/height 0.935 (concept 0.937). Cannon on his right arm in all seeds. Known defects (reports/blockout_report.md section 6): both arms reach ~45 degrees forward in all seeds (TRELLIS read the 3/4-drawn bore and fist as facing the viewer; a pose, not a shape problem), soft face (use the concept and s303's head), no seam/muzzle emissive, fused thick cape, baked lighting. The seed pick is an engineering judgement; the user's visual approval comes at stage 2.

2_production_mesh.notes: Production mesh made by the AI pipeline, not a stand-in; POLISHED on 2026-09-26 (massive layered arms, chunky gauntlet fists, the protruding anvil, stepped layered pauldrons, segmented legs, cracked stone-like gunmetal with lava joints; before / after in reports/stage2/stage2_before_after.png). The text below describes the first build where the polish did not change it. The CC0 MakeHuman hm08 topology (MPFB used as a tool only) is landmark-warped to the hero front's proportions (2.3 m, head sunk between the pauldrons, arm line at the anvil's top face, elbow-to-palm 0.40 m for the cannon sleeve, stance widened toward the brief) and conformed into an under-suit (legs to the blockout's outer armour envelope, a smooth barrel torso, forearms centred for the sleeve). The armour is 141 closed rigid pieces built from the concept (huge boxy pauldrons with glowing slots and upright plates, the anvil with a flat top face, horn left and two feet, shingled cuirass bands, chevron fauld and tassets, layered arm plates, per-phalanx gauntlet lames, cuisses, knee cops, greaves, blocky sabatons), a lofted beard with a moustache and five braids with gold rings and steel caps, and a separate thick war-red cape with a high collar and a tattered hem, planned for x_cape helper chains. One 2048 atlas: hand-painted NPR base colour from the declared colour script (value planes, cracked-plate mosaic, gold with a painted highlight band, the anvil's lighter top face, the cape's forge sigil, the scalp scar), a sparse emissive seam network with white-hot cores, and a tangent normal map baked from the s202 blockout (hit-distance and tilt filtered). The colossus_cannon GLB is attached at the recorded right-hand frame in the review; the forearm armour clears its sleeve. Review sheets in reports/stage2/; honest findings, the stage-3 helper-bone plan and the checklist in reports/stage2_production_mesh.md. The remaining human gate is the user's visual approval (item user_visual_approval).

changes: ARMS: both arms are the concept's massive layered fist arm: two rerebrace lames (r 0.15-0.16), a glowing elbow ring, a couter with a raised gold band and a cop, two vambrace segments (r 0.12-0.126, the second with a raised gold band), the gold wrist cuff, the gauntlet cuff. The right forearm lies inside the colossus_cannon sleeve WALL (the bore is 9.8 cm): 0 vertices out of its outer skin (ray-measured on the GLB); noted for the weapon track

GAUNTLETS: chunky plate fists: the under-suit glove at hand_scale 1.6, a thick back plate, a heavy knuckle guard with four gold studs, box-section finger lames as wide as each finger's share of the hand, so the four fingers close into one plated block

ANVIL: a protruding anvil 0.65 m in front of the spine line (flat top face 0.88 m wide at the arm line, horn to his left, strongly waisted body, two feet) over the breastplate, with the lava gasket glowing round its waist

PAULDRONS: three top lames stepping up from the front to the upright back plate (a staircase of lit bevels and dark tops from the 55-degree camera; thin gold rims only on the step edges and the outer-end chamfers; chipped outer corners), the cap block, the glowing slot, the lower block, the arm lame, a rounded gold-edged upright plate

LEGS: two gold-rimmed cuisse lames, big faceted knee cops (a 12 cm boss and side wings) with a glowing lava smile under them, greaves with a gold-edged raised shin plate over a lava gasket; huge blocky sabatons; the tassets rebuilt without their jagged end wall (it showed as a black notch at the right hip)

PLATE MATERIAL: cracked stone-like gunmetal (the declared #2A242E pulled 35 % toward the measured plate tone): a rectangular stone-block mosaic, painted value planes per plate and per face orientation, lit block bevels, dark joint cavities, chipped lighter hard edges, a lava vein network through the block joints with white-hot corners, and lava JOINTS where one plate meets another (a short-range AO bake); forge gold only on trims, rivets and bands; the normal map from the blockout kept
Gold rims widened from 1.6 to 2 cm (about 1 px at 22 m)
